paper_metadata.title: Effects of alloying elements on microstructure and mechanical properties of Co–Ni–Al–Ti superalloy

evidence.quote: The effects of the relative content of Al and Ti, and the addition of 2 at.% Cr or Mo to substitute partly Co on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Co-Ni-Al-Ti superalloy were investigated.

This study investigates the effects of the relative content of Al and Ti, and the addition of 2 at.% Cr or Mo to substitute partly Co on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Co-Ni-Al-Ti-base superallo ys.

mechanisms.name: lattice misfit effect on γ' morphology

evidence.quote: the variation of the morphology of the γ' phase in Fig. 4 was due to the change of the lattice misfit between γ' phase and γ matrix phase
It means that the lattice mis fit is indeed an effective strengthening mechanism.
Except for γ′ -precipitate hardening and solid solution strengthening, it also can be found that the measured vicker’s hardness values were directly correlated to the lattice misfit.
